title: Also this revival is super queer, they really are feeding us this pri...
transcript: I got to attend the press preview for New York Theatre Company's revival of Machinal this is a classic 1920s play inspired by a real life case of women murdering their husbands the play is fascinating on its own but this revival is infusing dance and foley effects and I have to show you these clips because it just looks and sounds so cool and I'm so excited for this this revival starts previews on June 7th at the New York City Centre in Stage 2 it is a very small space so get your tickets I cannot wait
